visualCharacteristics.purpose: Linked article cards with image, tag, date and title

contentPattern.structure: one row per article: (1) image; (2) tag paragraph, date paragraph, H3 title linked to the article
contentPattern.description: 4 linked article cards with image, tag, date, H3 title — Dynamic list of look-alike items each linking to a detail page with date and tag
contentPattern.notes: One row per card. rc3: image-only cards (text cell empty/omitted); rc5: image + tag + date + H3 title linked to article

reuseGuidance: Use for article teasers. The first link in the card (preferably in the title) makes the whole card clickable.
